title: PROV-AGENT Schema for ALA
description: Strict isomorphic formalization structure for anomaly detection events preserving causal lineage.

target_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent whose action was evaluated.

entropy_gradient.description: The calculated toolchain entropy gradient at the time of evaluation.

bicm_intent_coherence.description: BICM Intent Coherence score calculated from SEPAO graph.

time_to_decision_lag_ms.description: Latency in milliseconds from action request to triage decision.

hitl_verdict.description: The human-in-the-loop decision following a breach threshold event.

exploit_fingerprint_generated.description: Identifier or hash of the Symbolic Scar generated and stored in the STA.
